svg.title: VRL-Bench simulator and agent views of a selected retry-win WebShop case
svg.desc: Simulator View presents the shared first failure, a Reflexion-conditioned second-trial failure, and a successful memory-free second-trial retry as three repeated WebShop session rows. Agent View shows whether accumulated verbal history or an empty cross-trial context crosses reset into the Robot.
